Canada.title: After 20 years as a P.E.I. firefighter, something snapped. Now he's teaching others about PTSD

Canada.title: Age, speed limits for e-scooters and other personal electric vehicles hitting Manitoba roads next year

Canada.title: How some separatists are responding to Smith’s pledge against 2nd referendum if remain vote wins

Canada.title: Why this Fredericton woman is walking a Ukrainian battalion flag across P.E.I.

Canada.title: ‘Every rock has a story’: retired geologist opens rock library in Whitehorse

Canada.title: New church set to rise up after 'suspicious' fire in Kinngait, Nunavut

Canada.title: Could Quebec's new government derail plans for Alto's high-speed train project?

Canada.title: Man admits to 5 sex assaults near Winnipeg's Health Sciences Centre, including one against 14-year-old girl

Canada.description: In a decision issued Friday, the court said that even though Ottawa modified the law after the Supreme Court struck down much of it in 2023, the new law still infringes on provincial jurisdiction.

Canada.title: A Newfoundlander got a random call from a bunch of Hollywood stars — and just went with it

Canada.title: Residential school denialism shouldn't be illegal, Manitoba Premier Wab Kinew says
Canada.description: Residential school denialism is detestable but not illegal, and that shouldn't change, says Manitoba Premier Wab Kinew, who disagrees with federal Manitoba NDPer Leah Gazan's efforts to add it to the Criminal Code.

Canada.title: Top court sets sentencing framework for cases involving Indigenous offenders, victims
Canada.description: The ruling comes in the case of a Mi'kmaw man with severe mental health challenges who was sentenced in Nova Scotia to five years in prison after pleading guilty to aggravated assault against his partner, a Mi'kmaw woman.
